findings: Windows PowerShell 5.1 decodes node's UTF-8 output with the console code page, so refresh logs show '·' as '┬╖', and it wraps long lines at the console width. The logs stay readable and the evidence collector normalises both; refresh.ps1 could set UTF-8 console output to avoid it.
The daily task inherits Windows' mains-power conditions. On a laptop running on battery its runs wait until it is plugged in.
Without AIW_GITHUB_TOKEN one refresh uses about 50 of GitHub's 60 unauthenticated API calls per hour; a dry run and a real run cannot share one hour.
GH-DDD-CREW answers 422 and needs its connector checked; GH-APACHE-CAMEL and GH-MESHERY exceed what the refresh route can read and need the governed acquisition process.
